prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1301; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you state your full name for the record?
A: I'd rather just go by the claim details, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was going through a four-way intersection with a traffic light.
Q: What was the signal showing when you entered?
A: My light was green. I'm pretty sure of that because I'd just watched it change.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not until the last second. It came from my right side and clipped the driver's door area of my car.
Q: How fast were you traveling?
A: Probably around the posted limit, maybe a little under it. I wasn't rushing.
Q: Were you able to brake or swerve?
A: I hit the brakes, but there wasn't time to do much else.
Q: Did you receive any medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes, the paramedics checked me at the scene, and I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon.
Q: What injuries are you reporting?
A: My lower back is strained. It's sore when I sit or bend, and I've been taking it easy at home since then.
Q: Did you have any pain or problems with your back before this accident?
A: No, not that I can recall. I've been fairly active and haven't had treatment for my back before.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'm willing to provide any records you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
